name: reveal
description: Make a hidden entity known when the player notices, finds, or reaches it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the hidden entity.

name: move
description: Move an actor to a new location, or move a nearby item.

entity_id.description: Exact actor or item id. The item must be carried by the player or loose here.

to_id.description: Exact destination id. An actor moves to a location id. An item is taken by moving it to `player`, handed over by moving it to an actor here, and dropped by moving it to the id of the player's current location.

name: gain_improvised_item
description: Give the player an ordinary, unimportant object not already in the world.

item_name.description: The object's name, such as `a handful of gravel`.

name: add_trait
description: Add a lasting condition or quality to an entity.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

name.description: The trait's display name, such as `Battle Worn`; its id is derived.

text.description: The trait's effect in plain language.

name: remove_trait
description: Remove a lasting condition or quality that has ended.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Exact id of one of the entity's traits.

name: kill
description: Record that an actor has died. Their body and what they carried stay in the world.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor who has died. They must be here with the player.

name: advance_thread
description: Update an active storyline's status or note.

thread_id.description: Exact id of an ACTIVE THREAD.

status.description: New status, or null to keep the current status.

note.description: New private note for the Director, or null to keep the current note.

name: unlock_exit
description: Unlock an exit from the player's location.

to_id.description: Exact id of the exit's destination.

name: join_party
description: Add an actor here to the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor joining.

name: leave_party
description: Remove an actor from the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor leaving.

name: roll_question
description: Roll Chance against Risk for one closed dramatic question.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

question.description: Closed question where yes means the actor gets what they want.

position.description: Which side the relevant tags and situation favour.

edge.description: Tag or circumstance that sets the position. Empty for neutral.

opponent_id.description: Exact id of the actor or item here that resists. Null when nothing fights back.

name: restore_luck
description: Restore an actor's luck after a conflict ends.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or an actor here.

name: complete_chapter
description: Record that the current adventure has ended.

name: advance
description: Spend one advance a party member has earned, when the player asks for it. Choose the changes this adventure earned: a new skill, signature gear, a frailty, or a rewrite of an existing tag.

Change.description: One sheet change earned by the adventure.

tag.description: New title-case tag, or the exact current tag for a rewrite.

into.description: New title-case tag for a rewrite. Empty for other kinds.

why.description: One short reason, in the fiction, for this change.

Change.title: Change

parameters.description: All sheet changes earned by one adventure.

subject_id.description: Exact id of the party member who advances.

changes.description: Every earned change, in reading order.
